'''Gaib''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the partner and [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] of [[TK-0]]. He and TK specialized in stolen industrial technology as a kind of high tech [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. They had been hired by [[Kal Skirata]] to find [[Ko Sai/Legends|someone]] trying to beat the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] cloning ban. Providing information to the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class ARCs]] [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] and [[Ordo/Legends|Ordo]], the clones were led to a secret cloning base on [[Dorumaa]].

When [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], was kidnapped during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] hired Gaib and TK-0 to find the location of his son. They successfully traced Rotta's location to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. Jabba was so impressed with the pair's work, he kept them on retainer.
